label: Find ROIs
purpose: Rank the places where a population's objects gather, for review in the viewer
useWhen: Too many events to find by eye, and a population that marks them
Building a review queue for the viewer's ROI list
notWhen: You need per-object tracks: use tracking

params.label: Name
params.tip: Output name → rois/<name>.json; reviews are kept per name

params.requiredMessage: Select the objects to find ROIs for
params.label: Population
params.tip: The objects whose gatherings become ROIs

params.label: Rank by
params.tip: Optional: measures that make an object count more; none = count objects

params.label: Min objects
params.tip: Fewest objects, pooled over 12 frames, that make an ROI

params.label: Review labels
params.tip: Comma-separated labels offered when reviewing these ROIs
